title: Forward early-price validation (model-free, logging-first)
comment: Draft parameters. All analyses refuse while status != 'locked' or while any approved entry venue is unverified. Locking requires the decisions in docs/EXP-2026-11-B_DRAFT.md and must happen after the pilot ends and before any endpoint statistic is computed.
closing_reference_strong: football-data.co.uk Betfair Exchange close (BFECH/BFECD/BFECA), power de-vig
closing_reference_weak: approved venues' last complete pre-kickoff books within close_window_minutes, mean power de-vig
threshold_comment: null = no EV threshold: every fixture with a valid entry snapshot contributes exactly one entry, the argmax-EV selection. Pilot data (DK/FD overround 5-7%, cross-book disagreement median 0.78pp) imply an EV>0 rule would admit too few fixtures to reach min_n; thresholds are a secondary subgroup.
selection_function: soccerlab.expb.evaluate.select_entry: inputs = approved venues' complete unflagged books retrieved in [E - tolerance, E] (and >= locked_at) only; score_s = best_price_s * mean_power_devig_fair_s - 1; pick argmax, ties home>draw>away then venue name; threshold null

analyses.price_drift: descriptive; every selection, same venue early vs last pre-kickoff
analyses.closing_line: PRIMARY endpoint (closing EV vs strong reference); weak reference reported as EXP-2026-11-B-weak
analyses.simulated_roi: secondary only; never a lock or promotion criterion

closing_reference_strong_status: PROVISIONAL: football-data documents BFE* as 'Betfair Exchange' but not back/lay/mid, commission, or closing capture time

pilot.use: data-quality acceptance criteria only; excluded from every endpoint (quotes must be retrieved >= locked_at)
